findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so logs written through it are lost.
findings.body: `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. With a `TestLogger`, that call goes to a brand-new `TestLogger` from `NewTestLogger()`, not to the instance the test holds. So `InfoLogs.Calls`, `Message` and `Ctx` on the test's logger never change. Any test that checks the "Plugin Request Completed" log through a `TestLogger` will fail, or will quietly check nothing. Fix: return the receiver so calls are still recorded.
